requirement_text: This system shall provide real time redundancy and fault tolerance among the four FCCs and the NEFU.
requirement_text_raw: This system shall (3.1.4) provide real time redundancy and fault tolerance among the four FCCs and the NEFU.
user_story: As a mission manager, I want real time redundancy and fault tolerance among the four FCCs and the NEFU, so that a fault in one does not stop the system.
technical_task: Provide redundancy and fault tolerance in real time among the four FCCs and the NEFU.
acceptance_criteria: Given a fault in one of the four FCCs, when it occurs, then the system continues to operate through the remaining units in real time.
Given a fault in the NEFU, when it occurs, then the system continues to operate in real time.
rationale: Role assumed: mission manager. "Real time" is not quantified.

requirement_text: Clients shall be able to make a booking through the system.
user_story: As a client, I want to make a booking through the system, so that I can reserve a service.
technical_task: Provide a booking function for clients.
acceptance_criteria: Given the booking page, when a client submits a booking, then it is saved.
Given a saved booking, when the client views their bookings, then it is listed.

requirement_text: Individual or package job adverts shall be purchasable by credit card.
user_story: As an employer, I want to buy individual or package job adverts by credit card, so that I can post jobs.
technical_task: Accept credit card payment for individual and package job adverts.
acceptance_criteria: Given a job advert or a package, when the employer pays by credit card, then the purchase is completed.
Given a failed credit card payment, when it ends, then the advert is not purchased.

requirement_text: The website shall continue to operate if the payment gateway goes down.
requirement_text_raw: The website shall continue to operate if the payment gateway goes down.'
user_story: As a customer, I want the website to keep operating when the payment gateway goes down, so that I can still browse.
technical_task: Keep the website running when the payment gateway is unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: Given the payment gateway is down, when a customer uses the website, then the website continues to operate.
Given the payment gateway is down, when a customer tries to pay, then the website handles the failure without stopping.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. What the website does for payment during an outage is not stated.

requirement_text: Redundancy Management shall , within 60 milliseconds after 1.5 minutes has elapsed since the voted reset was sent to the failed channel, if the voted reset fails to recover the failed channel and alignment is still allowed, request from the application a power cycle of the channel. (Note that NEFU recovery does not depend on whether alignment is permitted.)
requirement_text_raw: Redundancy Management shall [SRS208], within 60 milliseconds after 1.5 minutes has elapsed since the voted reset was sent to the failed channel, if the voted reset fails to recover the failed channel and alignment is still allowed, request from the application a power cycle of the channel. (Note that NEFU recovery does not depend on whether alignment is permitted.)
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Redundancy Management to request a power cycle of a failed channel 60 milliseconds after 1.5 minutes have passed since the voted reset, if the reset did not recover it and alignment is still allowed, so that the channel gets a further recovery attempt.
technical_task: Within 60 milliseconds after 1.5 minutes have passed since the voted reset was sent, request an application power cycle of the failed channel if the reset failed and alignment is still allowed.
acceptance_criteria: Given 1.5 minutes have passed since the voted reset was sent and the channel is not recovered and alignment is still allowed, when Redundancy Management checks, then it requests from the application a power cycle of the channel within 60 milliseconds.
Given the channel has recovered, when Redundancy Management checks, then no power cycle is requested.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. NEFU recovery does not depend on alignment, per the note.

requirement_text: User shall be able to report errors encountered during system use.
user_story: As a user, I want to report errors I encounter while using the system, so that they can be fixed.
technical_task: Add an error report function that users can use during system use.
acceptance_criteria: Given an error during use, when the user reports it, then the report is saved.
Given a saved error report, when it is reviewed, then it describes the error.

requirement_text: Output reports include asset reports by location, request reports, and user permission reports.
user_story: As a manager, I want output reports including asset reports by location, request reports and user permission reports, so that I can review them.
technical_task: Generate asset reports by location, request reports and user permission reports.
acceptance_criteria: Given assets at several locations, when the user requests an asset report, then it is organized by location.
Given requests and user permissions, when the user requests request reports and user permission reports, then they are generated.
rationale: Role assumed: manager. "Include" means other reports may exist.

requirement_text: The reservation system shall allow users to reserve books even if they are currently borrowed by other members.
user_story: As a library member, I want to reserve a book even when it is borrowed by someone else, so that I get it when it returns.
technical_task: Allow reservations for books that are currently borrowed by other members.
acceptance_criteria: Given a book currently borrowed by another member, when a member reserves it, then the reservation is saved.
Given a reserved book, when it is returned, then it is held for the member who reserved it.
rationale: Role assumed: library member. The second criterion is an interpretation of reserving.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to view the detailed attributes of a single assignment.
user_story: As a student, I want to view the detailed attributes of a single assignment, so that I know exactly what it requires.
technical_task: Show a detail view of one assignment's attributes.
acceptance_criteria: Given an assignment, when the user opens it, then its detailed attributes are shown.
Given two assignments, when the user opens each, then each shows its own attributes.

requirement_text: User shall be able to link BADCamp attendees to their sponsorship page, to showcase attendance.
user_story: As an organizer, I want to link BADCamp attendees to their sponsorship page, so that attendance is showcased.
technical_task: Add a link from each BADCamp attendee to their sponsorship page.
acceptance_criteria: Given a BADCamp attendee with a sponsorship page, when the organizer links them, then the attendee is linked to the sponsorship page.
Given a linked attendee, when the sponsorship page is viewed, then the attendance is shown.
rationale: Role assumed: organizer; the requirement says user.

requirement_text: The system shall implement access control measures, such as secure validation methods on the cabin door.
user_story: As a facility manager, I want access control measures such as secure validation methods on the cabin door, so that only authorized people enter.
technical_task: Implement access control for the cabin, including secure validation on the cabin door.
acceptance_criteria: Given a person with valid validation, when the person uses the cabin door, then access is granted.
Given a person without valid validation, when the person tries the cabin door, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: facility manager. "Such as" means other measures may be used.

requirement_text: The system shall qualify the certainty of each sensed data item during acquisition, flagging doubtful data due to errors or unexpected values.
user_story: As a data analyst, I want the certainty of each sensed data item qualified during acquisition, with doubtful data flagged, so that I can judge the data.
technical_task: Assign a certainty qualification to each sensed data item at acquisition and flag items that are doubtful because of errors or unexpected values.
acceptance_criteria: Given a sensed data item, when it is acquired, then its certainty is qualified.
Given a data item with errors or unexpected values, when it is acquired, then it is flagged as doubtful.

requirement_text: The user interfaces shall be according to the Android User Interface Guidelines.
user_story: As a mobile user, I want the user interfaces to follow the Android User Interface Guidelines, so that the app feels familiar.
technical_task: Design the interfaces in line with the Android User Interface Guidelines.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user interface, when it is reviewed against the Android User Interface Guidelines, then it conforms.
Given all screens, when they are reviewed, then none violates the guidelines.
rationale: Role assumed: mobile user. The guidelines are not quoted.

requirement_text: It shall be usable by professionals, the unemployed, and students.
rationale: "Usable" is not defined and the needs of the three groups are not stated.
clarification_questions: What makes the system "usable" by professionals, the unemployed and students in measurable terms?
Does each group need different functions?

requirement_text: The supplier shall propose an electronic control unit concept and describe the details with quotation.
user_story: As a client, I want the supplier to propose an electronic control unit concept and describe its details with a quotation, so that I can evaluate the offer.
technical_task: Have the supplier propose an electronic control unit concept and provide its details together with a quotation.
acceptance_criteria: Given the supplier's proposal, when it is reviewed, then it contains an electronic control unit concept.
Given the proposal, when it is reviewed, then the details of the concept are described with a quotation.

requirement_text: The CBIT shall be executed without interfering with the normal execution of the application tasks.
requirement_text_raw: The CBIT shall (3.3.5.10) be executed without interfering with the normal execution of the application tasks.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the CBIT to run without interfering with normal application tasks, so that tasks are not disturbed.
technical_task: Run the CBIT so that it does not interfere with the normal execution of application tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Given the CBIT is running, when application tasks execute, then they execute normally.
Given the CBIT is running, when it is compared with a run without CBIT, then application task execution is not interfered with.

requirement_text: No invalid data shall be entered into the system.
user_story: As a data steward, I want no invalid data entered into the system, so that records stay valid.
technical_task: Validate all data on entry and reject invalid data.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid data, when it is entered, then it is accepted.
Given invalid data, when it is entered, then it is rejected.
rationale: Role assumed: data steward. What counts as invalid is not defined.

requirement_text: The system shall ensure a high level of availability, with minimal downtime for maintenance or upgrades.
rationale: "High level of availability" and "minimal downtime" are not quantified.
clarification_questions: What availability percentage counts as a "high level"?
How much downtime is "minimal" for maintenance or upgrades?

requirement_text: User shall not be able to choose show completed tasks, if these tasks are already shown.
user_story: As a user, I want the show completed tasks option to be unavailable when completed tasks are already shown, so that I don't toggle needlessly.
technical_task: Disable the show completed tasks choice when completed tasks are already displayed.
acceptance_criteria: Given completed tasks are already shown, when the user tries to choose show completed tasks, then the choice is not possible.
Given completed tasks are not shown, when the user chooses show completed tasks, then they are shown.

requirement_text: User shall be able to enroll a student's biometric data using fingerprint scanning.
user_story: As a teacher, I want to enroll a student's biometric data by fingerprint scanning, so that the student can be identified later.
technical_task: Provide fingerprint scanning to enroll a student's biometric data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a student, when a fingerprint is scanned for enrollment, then the biometric data is saved for the student.
Given an enrolled student, when the student's record is opened, then it shows that biometric data is enrolled.

requirement_text: The Teams app shall be designed to scale based on the size of the organization.
user_story: As an organization administrator, I want the Teams app to scale with the size of my organization, so that it keeps working as we grow.
technical_task: Design the Teams app so capacity grows with the size of the organization.
acceptance_criteria: Given a small organization, when it uses the Teams app, then the app works.
Given a larger organization, when it uses the Teams app, then the app works at the larger scale.
rationale: Role assumed: organization administrator. No sizes are given.

requirement_text: The autonomous partial braking intervention will be started earlier than that of CMS2 if the situation has reached a hazardous degree due to the missing escape route.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want the autonomous partial braking intervention to start earlier than that of CMS2 when the situation is hazardous because there is no escape route, so that braking helps sooner.
technical_task: Start the autonomous partial braking intervention earlier than the CMS2 intervention when the situation has reached a hazardous degree due to the missing escape route.
acceptance_criteria: Given a hazardous situation due to a missing escape route, when the intervention starts, then it starts earlier than the CMS2 intervention.
Given a situation that is not hazardous due to a missing escape route, when the intervention starts, then this earlier start does not apply.

requirement_text: Tester shall access test features in environments other than Staging for comprehensive testing.
user_story: As a tester, I want to access test features in environments other than Staging, so that I can test thoroughly.
technical_task: Make the test features available in environments other than Staging.
acceptance_criteria: Given an environment other than Staging, when a tester opens the system, then the test features are accessible.
Given the Staging environment, when a tester opens the system, then the test features remain accessible as before.
rationale: Role stated: tester. "Comprehensive" testing is not measured.

requirement_text: The administrator will store (1) hospital Id number for the hospital ; and (2) up to 30 alphanumeric characters giving the name of the hospital.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to store a hospital ID number and a hospital name of up to 30 alphanumeric characters, so that hospitals are identified.
technical_task: Store for each hospital an ID number and a name limited to 30 alphanumeric characters.
acceptance_criteria: Given a hospital, when the administrator enters an ID number and a name of up to 30 alphanumeric characters, then they are stored.
Given a name longer than 30 characters, when the administrator enters it, then it is not accepted.

requirement_text: The GSM bearer services [EN 301 515, Index [23]] to be supported are listed in table 2-2.
rationale: The sentence points to a table that is not given.
clarification_questions: Which GSM bearer services are listed in the referenced table?
Is the table part of this requirement?

requirement_text: Confirmation of remaining credits shall be provided after each job posting.
user_story: As an employer, I want confirmation of my remaining credits after each job posting, so that I know how many I have left.
technical_task: Show the employer's remaining credits after each job posting.
acceptance_criteria: Given a job posting is made, when it completes, then a confirmation of remaining credits is shown.
Given two job postings in a row, when the second completes, then the remaining credits reflect both.

requirement_text: Redundancy Management shall , if power cycle requests fail to result in a recovered channel, request the application to power down the channel and declare the channel to be permanently failed. Note that the same result will occur if the application software ignores or fails to respond to power cycle requests.
requirement_text_raw: Redundancy Management shall [SRS211], if power cycle requests fail to result in a recovered channel, request the application to power down the channel and declare the channel to be permanently failed.  Note that the same result will occur if the application software ignores or fails to respond to power cycle requests.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Redundancy Management to ask the application to power down a channel and declare it permanently failed when power cycle requests fail, so that a dead channel is retired.
technical_task: If power cycle requests do not recover the channel, request the application to power down the channel and declare it permanently failed, which also applies if the application ignores or fails to respond.
acceptance_criteria: Given power cycle requests fail to result in a recovered channel, when Redundancy Management handles it, then it requests the application to power down the channel and declares the channel permanently failed.
Given the application ignores or fails to respond to power cycle requests, when Redundancy Management handles it, then the channel is likewise declared permanently failed.

requirement_text: The system shall display an error message if the new user is not active in the Active Directory.
user_story: As an administrator, I want an error message shown when a new user is not active in the Active Directory, so that I know why the user cannot be added.
technical_task: Display an error message when the new user is not active in the Active Directory.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new user who is not active in the Active Directory, when the user is added, then an error message is displayed.
Given a new user who is active in the Active Directory, when the user is added, then no such error message is displayed.

requirement_text: The system shall display car information in a user-friendly format.
clarification_questions: What makes a format "user-friendly" for car information?
Which car information must be shown?

requirement_text: It defines a number of wiring and signaling standards for the Physical Layer of the OSI networking model, through means of network access at the Media Access Control (MAC) / Data Link Layer, and a common addressing format.
rationale: The sentence describes a networking standard and states no requirement for the system.
clarification_questions: What is "It" and what must the system do?
Is this a description of a standard rather than a requirement?

requirement_text: User shall upload examination questions and set parameters.
user_story: As an examiner, I want to upload examination questions and set parameters, so that exams are prepared.
technical_task: Provide upload of examination questions and settings for exam parameters.
acceptance_criteria: Given examination questions, when the user uploads them, then they are saved.
Given an exam, when the user sets parameters, then the parameters are saved.
rationale: Role assumed: examiner. The parameters are not listed.

requirement_text: User shall be able to browse items and see their pictures, prices, and other features.
user_story: As a shopper, I want to browse items and see their pictures, prices and other features, so that I can choose what to buy.
technical_task: Display items with pictures, prices and other features for browsing.
acceptance_criteria: Given items for sale, when the user browses, then they are listed.
Given an item in the list, when it is displayed, then its picture, price and other features are shown.

requirement_text: User shall browse and compare available products before making a purchase.
user_story: As a shopper, I want to browse and compare available products before buying, so that I can choose well.
technical_task: Offer product browsing and a comparison of available products before purchase.
acceptance_criteria: Given available products, when the user browses, then they are shown.
Given selected products, when the user compares them, then their features are shown together.

requirement_text: This documentation will be available in electronic files, and, with the exception of source code, in hard copy format.
user_story: As a project manager, I want documentation available as electronic files and, except for source code, as hard copy, so that it can be read in either form.
technical_task: Deliver the documentation as electronic files and provide hard copies of everything except source code.
acceptance_criteria: Given the documentation, when it is delivered, then it is available in electronic files.
Given the documentation other than source code, when it is delivered, then it is also available in hard copy format.

requirement_text: User shall be able to deposit datasets through Pure, ensuring a centralized platform for managing research outputs.
user_story: As a researcher, I want to deposit datasets through Pure, so that research outputs are managed in one central platform.
technical_task: Support dataset deposit through Pure.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dataset, when the user deposits it through Pure, then the dataset is deposited.
Given a deposited dataset, when research outputs are viewed, then it is listed in the central platform.

requirement_text: System shall redirect user to the particular company's portal upon selecting 'give up LPG subsidy' option.
user_story: As a gas customer, I want to be redirected to my company's portal when I select the give up LPG subsidy option, so that I can complete the process there.
technical_task: Redirect the user to the particular company's portal when the give up LPG subsidy option is selected.
acceptance_criteria: Given the give up LPG subsidy option, when the user selects it, then the user is redirected to the portal of the particular company.
Given another option, when the user selects it, then no redirect to the company's portal takes place.

requirement_text: The User agrees that absent express written authorization from the appropriate System Manager or the person designated in section 20 of this Agreement to do so the User shall not attempt to link records included in the file(s) specified in section 5 to any other individually identifiable source of information.
requirement_text_raw: The User agrees that  absent express written authorization from the appropriate System Manager or the person  designated in section 20 of this Agreement to do so  the User shall not attempt to link records included in the  file(s) specified in section 5 to any other individually identifiable source of information.
rationale: The sentence is a legal obligation on the user with no stated system behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement for the system or a condition of a data use agreement?
What must the system do to prevent linking of records?

requirement_text: The system shall generate reports on sales, inventory, prescriptions dispensed, etc.
user_story: As a manager, I want reports on sales, inventory and prescriptions dispensed, so that I can monitor the business.
technical_task: Generate reports on sales, inventory and prescriptions dispensed, among others.
acceptance_criteria: Given sales data, when the manager requests a sales report, then it is generated.
Given inventory or dispensed prescriptions, when the manager requests the related report, then it is generated.
rationale: Role assumed: manager. "Etc." means other reports may exist.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to view friends' stories, browse global stories, share stories, take screenshots, and report spam content.
user_story: As a user, I want to view friends' stories, browse global stories, share stories, take screenshots and report spam content, so that I can use the story features.
technical_task: Provide viewing of friends' stories, browsing of global stories, sharing, screenshots and spam reporting.
acceptance_criteria: Given friends with stories, when the user opens them, then friends' stories are shown.
Given global stories, when the user browses, then they are shown, and the user can share a story, take a screenshot or report spam content.

requirement_text: User shall have a profile page where they can edit information such as password, email address, and phone number.
user_story: As a user, I want a profile page where I can edit my password, email address and phone number, so that my details stay current.
technical_task: Create a profile page with editing of password, email address and phone number.
acceptance_criteria: Given the profile page, when the user changes the email address or phone number, then the change is saved.
Given the profile page, when the user changes the password, then the new password is saved.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Such as" means other fields may exist.

requirement_text: On the other hand the routine will be stopped if the battery current does not become small enough while zero current control is forced.
user_story: As a battery engineer, I want the routine stopped when the battery current does not become small enough while zero current control is forced, so that it does not run forever.
technical_task: Stop the routine when the battery current does not become small enough while zero current control is forced.
acceptance_criteria: Given zero current control is forced, when the battery current does not become small enough, then the routine is stopped.
Given zero current control is forced, when the battery current becomes small enough, then the routine is not stopped for this reason.
rationale: Role assumed: battery engineer. "Small enough" is not quantified.

requirement_text: The solution should provide reports for records of information solution activity such as audit logs access reports and security incident tracking reports.
requirement_text_raw: The solution should provide reports for records of information solution activity  such as audit logs  access reports  and security incident tracking reports.
user_story: As a compliance officer, I want reports of solution activity such as audit logs, access reports and security incident tracking reports, so that I can review what happened.
technical_task: Provide reports of information solution activity including audit logs, access reports and security incident tracking reports.
acceptance_criteria: Given solution activity, when the user requests an audit log report, then it is produced.
Given access and security incidents, when the user requests an access report or a security incident tracking report, then it is produced.

requirement_text: For details see [PLGW_R-109] chapters `` Generation of Scc_15118MessagingControl enable '' [SCC-6317] and `` Generation of Scc_15118MessagingControl disable '' [SCC-7145].
rationale: The sentence only points to chapters of another document.
clarification_questions: What do the referenced chapters on enabling and disabling Scc_15118MessagingControl require?
Is the referenced document part of this requirement?

requirement_text: Subscription packages shall have a duration of one month.
user_story: As a customer, I want subscription packages to last one month, so that I know how long I am covered.
technical_task: Set the duration of subscription packages to one month.
acceptance_criteria: Given a subscription package, when it is purchased, then it runs for one month.
Given a subscription package one month after purchase, when the month ends, then it expires.

requirement_text: In cases of faults such as incorrect polarity, overvoltage, short circuits, etc. the component must not be damaged.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want the component not to be damaged by faults such as incorrect polarity, overvoltage and short circuits, so that it survives wiring mistakes.
technical_task: Protect the component against incorrect polarity, overvoltage, short circuits and similar faults.
acceptance_criteria: Given incorrect polarity, when it is applied to the component, then the component is not damaged.
Given an overvoltage or a short circuit, when it is applied, then the component is not damaged.
rationale: Role assumed: hardware engineer. "Etc." means other faults may be covered.

requirement_text: The APAF system shall process the engineering and ancillary information necessary for calibration and science validation into IDFS data sets.
requirement_text_raw:
The APAF system shall process the engineering and ancillary information necessary for calibration and science validation
into IDFS data sets.
user_story: As a calibration scientist, I want the APAF system to process the engineering and ancillary information needed for calibration and science validation into IDFS data sets, so that I can calibrate and validate.
technical_task: Convert the engineering and ancillary information required for calibration and science validation into IDFS data sets in the APAF system.
acceptance_criteria: Given engineering and ancillary information needed for calibration and science validation, when the APAF system processes it, then IDFS data sets are produced.
Given an IDFS data set, when it is opened, then it contains the processed information.

requirement_text: The solution should implement two-factor authentication for granting remote access to solutions that contain EPHI.
user_story: As a security officer, I want two-factor authentication for remote access to solutions that contain EPHI, so that remote access is protected.
technical_task: Require two-factor authentication before remote access is granted to solutions containing EPHI.
acceptance_criteria: Given a remote user and a solution containing EPHI, when the user provides both authentication factors, then remote access is granted.
Given a remote user who provides only one factor, when the user requests access to a solution containing EPHI, then access is not granted.

requirement_text: Broker user shall have updated error codes that accurately reflect logic and provide enough information.
rationale: "Accurately reflect logic" and "enough information" are not measurable.
clarification_questions: Which error codes must be updated and what must they reflect?
What is "enough information" in testable terms?

requirement_text: The FDIR shall execute CBIT during all operational phases.
requirement_text_raw: The FDIR shall (3.3.5.4) execute CBIT during all operational phases.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FDIR to execute CBIT during all operational phases, so that built-in tests run continuously.
technical_task: Run CBIT from FDIR in every operational phase.
acceptance_criteria: Given any operational phase, when FDIR runs, then it executes CBIT.
Given a change of operational phase, when it occurs, then CBIT is still executed in the new phase.

requirement_text: The HCP selects a patient to deactivate.
user_story: As an HCP, I want to select a patient to deactivate, so that inactive patients are marked.
technical_task: Let the HCP choose a patient and deactivate them.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient, when the HCP selects the patient to deactivate, then the patient is deactivated.
Given a deactivated patient, when the patient list is viewed, then the patient is shown as deactivated.
